body:
OK, Teens it’s time to get focused and possibly uncomfortable. The new class PG-13 is a scene stufy and audition technique class that is designed to prepare teens in specific content and strategies. You asked for it and its here.

Real Talk: Handling the Tough Stuff Teen roles aren't all sunshine and rainbows. This class gets real about handling mature themes and complex scenes (rated PG-13, just FYI). You'll learn how to tackle them with confidence and respect – because, let's face it, that's where the juicy roles are.

Forget Typecasting, Own Your Type Tired of being labeled the 'best friend' or the 'funny sidekick'? This class is about owning your type and using it to your advantage. You'll learn how to make even the most familiar character feel fresh and unforgettable.

Audition Like a Boss Ever freeze up during auditions? Or feel like everyone else is doing the same thing? This class teaches you how to make choices that are bold AF. You'll learn how to leave an impression that makes casting directors be like, "Okay, who was THAT?"

Scene Study Deep Dive Memorizing lines isn't enough. This class teaches you how to break down a scene so you understand your character like your BFF. Your performances will have way more depth, and those auditions? You'll crush 'em.

Class Deets (You Know, the Important Stuff)

  • Led by Corey Ralston of Child Actor 101

  • Ages 13 and up

  • $145 for the whole four-week course

  • Starts April 1st, sessions on Mondays at 4:30 PM Pacific

  • It's all on Zoom, so no excuses if you're not in a big city

Let's be real, the acting world is tough. But this class? It's the secret weapon that'll turn you into a force to be reckoned with. It's not just about learning lines – it's about unlocking the actor you were meant to be.
